description: This file contains a PHPUnit test class 'ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategyTest' used to verify the behavior of the 'ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategy' class in the OrangeHRM system. It tests the purging operations on Employee entities, ensuring fields are correctly replaced with specific values according to defined strategies. The tests include setup, purge methods, and retrieval of internal strategies, focusing on core purge functionality within the plugin's namespace.

classes.name: ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategyTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case for testing the 'ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategy' class functionalities within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin, focusing on field value replacement and record purging behavior.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test environment, creates an instance of ReplaceWithValuePurgeStrategy with configuration, and populates fixture data.

methods.name: testPurge
methods.description: Verifies that the purge method correctly updates Employee entity fields with predefined purge values.

methods.name: testPurgeRecord
methods.description: Ensures that purging a specific employee record correctly applies the replacement values.

methods.name: testGetReplaceStrategy
methods.description: Tests internal method to retrieve appropriate value formatter strategies by name.

methods.description: Helper to invoke the protected method 'getReplaceStrategy' on the class under test, returning specific formatter instances.
